dict.string: Point the camera at a platform sign or the train's destination display to check you're boarding in the right direction. Images are processed on your device and never saved or sent.
Used to find the nearest subway station and to check which station you're at while riding.
Listens to the in-train announcements to confirm the current station and which side the doors open. Audio is processed on your device and never saved or sent.
Uses the accelerometer to detect when the train departs and stops, so the current station stays accurate while you ride.
Recognizes station names in the in-train announcements. Recognition happens entirely on your device.
